label: Like Terms
subgoals: Like terms have the same variable part.
Constants are like terms with no variable, so they combine with each other.

label: The Distributive Property
subgoals: A factor outside parentheses multiplies every term inside.
When the factor is negative, watch the signs of every term inside the parentheses.

label: A Simplified Expression
subgoals: An expression is simplified when no parentheses remain and no like terms can be combined.
Simplification does not change the value of the expression for any input.
Write the result with the variable terms first and the constant last, following the usual convention.
